Contributes to: https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/63686

This change splits source gen and reflection JsonTypeInfos making it that effectively every `JsonTypeInfo` is now `JsonTypeInfo<T>`.

Also large chunk of caching is cleaned up in preperation for contract customization (#63686). This doesn't include all of the required caching changes yet.

Some of the behavior around exceptions got changed:
- before this change in fast path we sometimes threw JsonException (side effect of JsonReader/JsonWriter throwing) and no-fast we threw InvalidOperationException - now it's consistent and we throw InvalidOperationException in both cases
- fast path previously always threw on deserialization when it didn't have enough type info (no info about properties) - in certain scenarios it's possible to deserialize such types, i.e.: we're deserializing empty object `{}` we can still return correct answer as there we don't need to look up for properties.

Couple of notes on JsonTypeInfo/JsonPropertyInfo:
- JsonPropertyInfo.NumberHandling now becomes EffectiveNumberHandling (considers otpions and declaring type), while NumberHandling is equivalent to NumberHandlingAttribute setting
- JsonTypeInfo/JsonPropertyInfo after construction is incomplete (some settings can still be changed, this is in preparation for edititing), once `Configure()` is called it becomes complete and it should not be edited anymore (right now it's not enforced because nothing editable is public)

cc: @dotnet/area-system-text-json

A few more remarks:

* This is an awesome refactoring that removes a lot of tech debt from the JsonTypeInfo infrastructure.
* Could you try removing all the `is JsonTypeInfo<T>` checks in some of the root serialization methods? They are known to be slow and have been a source of performance problems.
* We might be able to avoid a few casts if `JsonTypeInfo<T>` contained a property to `JsonConverter<T>`. Is this feasible or useful to add?
* `JsonConverter<T>` defines [a handful of helper methods](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/src/libraries/System.Text.Json/src/System/Text/Json/Serialization/JsonConverterOfT.cs#L57-L65) meant to facilitate creation of generic `JsonPropertyInfo<T>` and `JsonParameterInfo<T>` instances. Might we be able to use the same trick for creating `JsonTypeInfo<T>` instances without resorting to reflection?
* Given this is a substantial refactoring, could you run our benchmark against the PR branch to make sure no accidental regressions have crept in? I like to use [statistical tests against the current main](https://github.com/dotnet/performance/blob/main/src/benchmarks/micro/README.md#private-runtime-builds) when doing that.
